en.headline: Six-year-old girl injured after taxi hits her on Sha Tau Kok Road
en.dek: Police arrested a 44-year-old taxi driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after the girl was hit while crossing near Ma Mei Ha.
body: Police said a six-year-old girl was injured after being hit by a taxi on Sha Tau Kok Road in the New Territories on Saturday afternoon.

Officers received a report at about 5.45pm that a taxi travelling towards Fanling had struck the girl as she was crossing the road near the Ma Mei Ha section. Ambulance crews found the girl conscious with injuries to her leg and head, and took her to Prince of Wales Hospital.
The 44-year-old male taxi driver passed a breath test. After investigation, police arrested him on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. He was detained for further enquiries.

zh.headline: 沙頭角公路的士撞傷過路6歲女童 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指下午約5時45分接報，女童腳部及頭部受傷但清醒，44歲的士司機涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。
body: 警方表示，周六下午沙頭角公路發生交通意外，一名6歲女童被的士撞傷。
警方下午約5時45分接報，一輛的士沿沙頭角公路往粉嶺方向行駛，至馬尾下段時懷疑撞到正在過路的女童。救護人員到場時女童清醒，腳部及頭部受傷，送往威爾斯親王醫院治理。
44歲的士男司機通過酒精測試。警方調查後以涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害將他拘捕，現正扣留調查。
